column1: # One row per old name. Read by the old-term lint (slice R3) and by retrieval
# (slice R4: qmd query documents, graphify seeds), and listed by the removal
# slice X. scripts/lib/test-rename-aliases.sh pins the shape.
# Columns (TAB-separated; the first non-comment line is the header):
#   old        the old name. Prose rows are matched as written (whole words, any
#              case); env rows are exact names, or a prefix when kind is
#              env-prefix (a trailing * = starts with; anchored at the START of
#              the name, so CONSOLE_* never matches HIMMEL_CONSOLE_FG_OK).
#   new        the new name, or - when the row only pins an old name.
#   kind       prose | env | env-prefix | marker | do-not-rename
#   direction  env rows, how scripts/lib/env-alias.sh resolves OLD against NEW:
#                restrict  a marker or disable switch; either name truthy = on
#                permit    an *_OK override or widening switch; any set falsy
#                value     a value key (path, model, timeout); alias_env
#              prose rows, the severity of the old term in an added line:
#   slice      the rename slice that performs the rename (R2, V1, V2, V3,
#              V4a, V5, D), or - for a do-not-rename row
#   remove-at  X = the removal slice deletes the read-both path; never = the
#              row stays (a vocabulary bridge or a do-not-rename entry)
# A consumer takes the FIRST row that matches, so an exact name sits above the
# prefix that would also match it.
# The ruled terms are the operator's 2026-10-20 decision (chief, worker,
# dependency chain, parallel wave). HIMMEL_WORKER is the dispatched-lane
# security marker: no worker-session name may start with HIMMEL_WORKER_ unless
# SESSION_ follows. HIMMEL_CONSOLE_* stays (OD-1, kept by default).
